regime_context: The policy regime is a sequenced, alignment-based campaign to engineer structurally lower real yields while holding rate-cut optics: the Fed (Warsh) banks inflation credibility with a hike-majority posture, while Treasury (Bessent) suppresses front-end yields. The consensus treats this as coordinated easing; revealed interest shows easing is inflation-gated optionality, not a near-term path.
regime_context_zh: 当前政策体制是一场分阶段、基于利益对齐的行动：美联储（沃什）以偏鹰姿态积攒通胀信誉，财政部（贝森特）压制前端收益率，从而在结构上压低实际利率。市场共识将其解读为协同宽松，但显示性偏好表明宽松是受通胀约束的期权，而非近期路径。

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: Iran ceasefire collapse (7/8) re-primed the energy rotation; XLE was already the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026 on conflict. A hawkish Fed that has not yet delivered supply relief leaves oil upside-skewed on headlines.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗停火破裂（7/8）重新点燃了能源板块轮动；XLE 在 2026 年第一季度本就因冲突成为 ETF 资金流入最多的板块。美联储仍偏鹰且尚未带来供给缓解，使油价在消息面上偏向上行。
evidence: Iran / Middle East theater: ceasefire COLLAPSED, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday 7/8
theses.dissent: A rapid ceasefire reinstatement or Hormuz transit normalization would unwind the risk premium from the same two-sided headline.
theses.dissent_zh: 若迅速恢复停火或霍尔木兹海峡通行正常化，同样的双向消息面将消化掉风险溢价。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's Fed is in a stagflationary-split posture: with CME FedWatch >70% probability of a September hike and hot May PCE, the long-duration complex faces a hike-majority market even as Treasury suppresses front-end yields.
theses.thesis_zh: 沃什领导下的美联储处于滞胀分化姿态：CME FedWatch 显示 9 月加息概率超过 70%，且 5 月 PCE 偏热，即使财政部压制前端收益率，长久期资产仍面临加息主导的市场环境。
evidence: open_predictions: The Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 (hold or hike)
market: fed_path_gap shows market ≈ Fed at end-2026
7/13 update: CME FedWatch >70% Sept hike probability
theses.dissent: A widening labor crack (June payrolls +57k vs expected) is the one leg that could force a data-driven September pivot, which would rally long duration hard.
theses.dissent_zh: 若劳动力缺口扩大（6 月非农 +5.7 万，低于预期），是唯一可能迫使美联储转向数据驱动的 9 月宽松的因素，届时长久期资产将大幅反弹。

falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日期前 TLT 跑赢 SPY 达 5%

theses.subject: UUP
theses.thesis: Bessent's 'strong dollar while cutting' is the FX bridge; with the Iran haven bid and manufactured demand to keep the ~$9.7T FY2026 refi math viable, the dollar stays bid as a policy instrument, not a Mar-a-Lago casualty.
theses.thesis_zh: 贝森特的“在降息的同时维持强势美元”是汇率桥梁；借助伊朗避险买盘和人为制造的需求来维持约 9.7 万亿美元的 2026 财年再融资能力，美元作为政策工具仍受买盘支撑，而非“海湖庄园协议”的牺牲品。
evidence: Dollar/debt theater: FACT (GENIUS) reinforces front-end Treasuries + low-real-yield regime
thesis: Bessent's 6/24 'strong dollar while cutting' is the FX bridge
DXY ~100.9 well off 13-mo high suggests room
theses.dissent: A genuine Mar-a-Lago accord turn (theoretical, low odds) would be explicitly dollar-bearish and would invalidate the strong-dollar bridge.
theses.dissent_zh: 若真正转向“海湖庄园协议”（理论性、概率低），将明确利空美元，并使强势美元桥梁失效。

theses.subject: ITA
theses.thesis: NATO defense spending super-cycle is structural and high-confidence: budget commitments plus missile-defense/Golden Dome capex keep primes bid regardless of the oil/ceasefire two-sidedness.
theses.thesis_zh: 北约国防开支超级周期是结构性且高置信度的：预算承诺加上导弹防御/“金穹”资本开支使军工主线持续受买盘支撑，与油价/停火的双向波动无关。
evidence: NATO/Defense theater: FACT (budget/NATO) — structural spending super-cycle
rotation_targeted: Defense · shipbuilding · missile defense, proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD
theses.dissent: Recent ITA overweight call missed; if fiscal sequencing delays defense appropriations, the structural bid may take longer than the trade horizon to price.
theses.dissent_zh: 近期 ITA 超配判断已失误；若财政排程延迟国防拨款，结构性买盘可能需要更长时间才会被定价。
